Attempting to also pixel-measure the interior doors is not feasible since they appear only in plan, not in any elevation, and the main/typical exterior doors on other elevations lack an isolated, unobstructed outline with a nearby calibrated dimension chain of the same quality checked here. No further useful, feasible, bounded action remains within scope; further micro-precision passes (e.g., re-deriving the same 2.15m to more decimal places) would not change fidelity. Selecting candidate_06 as final.
